test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

#: QSO:: XZV: %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Option 1) # = SFR, % = POS

For # (SFR) to QSO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/934bd3bb24cf5cfaf9a8687760c041ba5a0dbb3dc3ebaa73e093b8848787f35a.png] 

 

For XZV to % (POS)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45cb86c1241d4ac6f3d37d4994c8f4620de3326873e1267213769587daba2133.png] 

 

**Option 2) # = TVR, % = UWS**

For # (TVR) to QSO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43f12dd9c0802020c821d9b3229c9fb26cdb45991c3c1d14b239fe80e50b04db.png] 

 

For XZV to % (UWS)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43f12dd9c0802020c821d9b3229c9fb26cdb45991c3c1d14b239fe80e50b04db.png] 

 

**Since the pattern for TVR to QSO (-3, -3, -3) is the same as the pattern for XZV to UWS (-3, -3, -3), **

**Option 2 is correct.**

Option 3) # = TUR, % = UET

For # (TUR) to QSO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d980768f6151e39dde6f65fe008cc28eb108a01f28a23a766d50269f01364a2.png] 

For XZV to % (UET)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eceafd03cdaf68ea2158b87354a535488b58eeeccf84d3ce67c4b1ea4fb4d4bb.png] 

Option 4) # = SVR, % = UWU

For # (SVR) to QSO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ddeab5ee573bd94b5d31c7cf0892bd9dcc1961dba8f40a0acf37572122b0982.png] 

For XZV to % (UWU)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d04f406d90e2d93f6c8149d38e1f6929a6919365a5cdfe04db4d1fed75445f65.png] 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
